payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the G-SAT model consistently outperforms existing systems in terms of accuracy and efficiency, as demonstrated through various experiments on the WOZ2.0 dataset.

claims.text: The G-SAT model outperforms state-of-the-art DST systems in terms of accuracy, achieving higher scores on the dev and test sets compared to GLAD and GCE.
The G-SAT model provides competitive advantages over existing systems, being over 15 times faster while maintaining high accuracy.
